notes.subject: acĩ
notes.rationale: Hebrew has plural forms of tribal-collective names; Gĩkũyũ needs a plural word

notes.subject: Akereti na Apereti
notes.rationale: הכרתי והפלתי: guard-corps names (maybe Cretans and Philistines) left as names, not as 'life-guardsmen'

notes.subject: hakĩrĩkanĩro-inĩ ha mwathi
notes.rationale: ליד המלך literally 'at the hand of the king', an idiom for serving in the king's presence

notes.subject: arĩa mbere
notes.rationale: הראשנים: 'the first' — rank (chief officials) vs age (eldest sons); rank kept

translation: Na Benajahu mũrũ wa Yehojada aarĩ igũrũ wa ⟨acĩ Akereti na Apereti⟩; na arĩa a mũrũ arĩa macio a Dawidi, arĩa mbere, mahotagĩra hau hakĩrĩkanĩro-inĩ ha mwathi.
